vb_textbox.text: I picked the brown and purple gnome for a while. This would give between 5-9 points which was a decent score. After a while this score would drop so I would pick another - quote often the dark pink worked well. Then I'd go back to the brown and purple gnomes. This sometimes worked well. Other times there didn't appear to be a pattern.Keep trying things out and noting what happens. The flat blue gnomes rarely worked well for me. I didn't choose the rare gnome with the dark grey hat so I don't know the result you'd get with that one.
